benchmarks.equal_weight: same top-N PIT universe, fully rebalanced monthly, identical timing and costs
benchmarks.unbanded_inverse_vol: same inverse-vol target, fully rebalanced monthly with no drift band

costs.turnover: sum(abs(target_weight-current_weight)); initial allocation and final liquidation included

data.verification: before calculation, verify_snapshot(snapshot_id, expected_dataset, minimum_stage=curated) must return integrity VERIFIED and quality PASS; exact manifest and every registered file SHA must replay, otherwise DATA_ERROR_STOP

execution.continuous_state: one continuous simulation; no liquidation or reset at train/OOS/holdout boundaries
execution.decision: last close before the first UTC daily open of each calendar month
execution.entry: next UTC daily open after the decision close
execution.incumbent_for_band: actual holdings marked at decision close and normalized by total portfolio equity
execution.incumbent_for_turnover: actual holdings marked at execution open immediately before trade and normalized by total portfolio equity
execution.return_path: daily open-to-next-open; terminal final-open-to-close then exit

formula.band_trigger: first allocation triggers without a ratio; compare membership next and if different trigger without a ratio; only when memberships match, evaluate common members and trigger if any abs(decision_close_incumbent-target)/target > band; common-member target weights are strictly positive; a trigger rebalances the full portfolio at next open
formula.selection: first require complete 90-volume-bar and 31-close history for active PIT names; fewer than N is DATA_ERROR_STOP; then sort median quote_volume descending and canonical symbol ascending
formula.volatility: sample stdev of 30 completed close-to-close daily returns through decision close, annualized by sqrt(365)
formula.weight: (1/volatility) / sum(1/volatility); volatility sizes only and never determines long/short direction

mechanism: cross-sectional inverse-vol risk budgeting with wide drift bands can retain unbanded risk diversification at materially lower turnover

metrics.calmar: compounded annualized net return / abs(max drawdown)
metrics.concentration: per-symbol arithmetic gross contribution minus that symbol's actual transaction cost; largest absolute contribution / sum absolute contributions
metrics.daily_return: portfolio open-to-next-open gross return minus actual turnover cost at that open; terminal uses final-open-to-close minus exit cost
metrics.invalid_metric: empty input, zero/negative/non-finite denominator, zero/non-finite sample volatility, zero contribution denominator, or any non-finite metric makes the associated check false
metrics.max_observed_weight: maximum absolute live symbol weight observed at daily opens after trade and at scheduled decision closes
metrics.sharpe: mean daily net return / sample stdev daily net return * sqrt(365)
metrics.total_return: compounded product of one plus daily net returns minus one

parameters.selection_rule: primary fixed before run; grid points are stability diagnostics and cannot replace it

parameter_stability.grid_point_required: in both OOS and holdout: baseline total return and Sharpe positive; baseline Sharpe > equal-weight; stress total return and Sharpe positive; stress Sharpe >= equal-weight stress; turnover ratio vs unbanded <= 0.75
